title: Schumer Amendment to NDAA gutted; Mike Turner role
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Schumer Amendment to NDAA gutted; Mike Turner role, about 2023 at Washington, D.C., and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: just look at last year we had this Schumer Amendment to the National Defense authorization act which got entirely gutted

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2023 a proposed addition to the yearly US defence law, the National Defense Authorization Act, put forward by Senator Chuck Schumer and aimed at releasing UFO information, was entirely gutted. Michels points to a congressman named Mike Turner as part of that story, which he offers as a sign that some in Congress worked to block disclosure.
